name: cli-session-lifecycle-guards
body: The session lifecycle guards: the checks that keep the session the exclusive owner of the worktree database. `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan` and `rust.apg.project_cmd.merge.project_merge_at` refuse while a session is live so the caller saves and ends first; the shared freshness fast path in `rust.apg.pipeline.run_pipeline` consults the session socket so a stale-socket detection rebuilds the derived index ahead of a scan.
